title: Browser delivery v2 qualifying timeline and incident markers
$comment: Qualifying-safe timeline artifact. Carries bounded half-open [startMs, endMs) yellow/red track-status intervals plus separately named incidentMarkers for track-map marker hiding. Race semantics (dnfMarkers, OUT, finish, position) are never represented here. The artifact is optional and qualifying-like-only; absence means no interval rendering and no incident marker hiding (fail closed). When present, intervals and incidentMarkers are both required keys and each may be an empty array; the artifact should be omitted entirely when there is nothing to publish. Marker and interval times are causal (effective when <= replayTimeMs). incidentMarkers are ordered deterministically by timeMs, then driverId, then rawMessage; later implementation validates ordering, artifact bounds (startMs <= time < endMs), driver identity against the manifest, and digest. Marker source is either race-control-car-event (canonical CarEvent terminal evidence) or red-flag-position-freeze (visibility-only inference from position telemetry when a driver with valid pre-red evidence froze through a finite red interval); unknown sources are rejected. Inferred freeze markers are derived at the exclusive end of finite red intervals, carry the canonical rawMessage RED FLAG, and never change classification, status, OUT, DNF, or finish semantics.
